claims: Usher and Chris Brown officially announced a joint "Raymond & Brown" (R&B) Tour for 2026 via social media on April 10, 2026.
The official name of the tour is the "Raymond & Brown" Tour (or R&B Tour).
Usher and Chris Brown released a teaser video on April 10, 2026.
The teaser video shows Usher and Chris Brown on motorcycles.
The tour is a co-headlining multi-city tour expected to take place later in 2026.
As of April 10, 2026, specific tour dates have not been released.
As of April 10, 2026, specific city venues have not been released.
As of April 10, 2026, ticket sale dates have not been released.
